% appA.tex -- writer W5. Appendix A: constants and side conditions. The tables are generated by verify_constants.py.
\section{Constants and side conditions}\label{app:const}

The proofs use finitely many explicit numbers. The \emph{inputs} are: $\vz=5.8\cdot10^{-3}$, $\epsS=4\cdot10^{-11}$ and the bound
$13.1$ of Theorem~\ref{thm:main}; the touch-down parameters $(\vbar,\eta,\epsbar,\xi_1,\lambda_0,G_{\mathrm T})$; the touch-down constants
as printed in Theorem~\ref{thm:touchdown} and Lemma~\ref{lem:T2star}, with $a'=0.9827002$ and $C_0=c_N$; the free parameters of the end
theorem, the dependent quantities $\dL,\delta_1,\nu,A_0,\fF,\gD$ (rounded up) and the values of $D'$ of Lemma~\ref{lem:Ne}, all in
Table~\ref{tab:core}; and $\bar\omega$, $c_k$, $\delta_0/R$ (Table~\ref{tab:asm}). Every other constant is defined by a closed formula: those
of Definition~\ref{def:tdconst} from the touch-down parameters, those of Definition~\ref{def:param} from the tuple $p$ resp.\ $\pA$,
$U_0=U_{\max}$ resp.\ $U_0=\UA$, and the function $\Cfl$ of \eqref{eq:asm}, and those of Section~\ref{sec:proof} from all of these. Each
side condition is an inequality between two such numbers.

The script \texttt{verify\_constants.py} (Python~3 with \texttt{mpmath} and \texttt{numpy}, no other dependency) first computes the
certified upper bounds of Lemma~\ref{lem:Ne} for $D'$ at $p$ and at $\pA$, as described in its proof. It then evaluates all formulas in
$50$-digit arithmetic at exactly the printed inputs and checks $218$ inequalities, in seven groups: that the certified bounds do not exceed
the printed values of $D'$ ($2$); (SC1)--(SC48) of Definition~\ref{def:tdconst} ($52$ inequalities, as (SC16), (SC37), (SC47), (SC48)
consist of two each), together with $\lambda_0\le\frac14$, $\kc\ge\frac12$, $c_N\lambda_0^{1-\muTb}\le1$ and $\vbar\le2\cdot10^{-2}$, which
the proofs do not use ($4$); that each touch-down constant used in Theorem~\ref{thm:touchdown}, Lemma~\ref{lem:T2star} and later lies on
the safe side of its exact value ($13$; $c_{\mathrm{sep}}$, $\kc$, $\czlo$ rounded down, the others up); (P0)--(P8) for $p$ and for $\pA$
($2\times36$); (C1)--(C6) for $p$ and for $\pA$ ($2\times6$); (A2)--(A7) of Section~\ref{sec:proof} ($37$, including (TS), (PT),
$a'\le1-\muTb$ and $\Tsharp\le13.1$); and $26$ further inequalities. Of the latter, $20$ are elementary inequalities that the proofs use in
passing (such as $c_\tau\ge1$, $\zeta\le1$, $W_{\mathrm v},W_{\mathrm t}\ge1$, $\sA_{\max}<2$, $\lambda_0<1$, $m_0\le1$ and $e_\rho/\sqrt3\le1$
for the $\arcsin$ in Definition~\ref{def:tdconst}, $\pi/2+\eta<2$ and $2\pi-2\eta>4$ in Lemma~\ref{lem:len}; two of them, $\vbar^2\le\frac12$ and $\eta\le1$, are recorded for completeness only), and $6$ are the inequalities
$\Cmu\ge(1+2\gamma)\kappa/c_A$, $\gamma\le c_A/\kappa$ and $K_f(2\gamma-1)\le3c_A/\kappa$ for $p$ and for $\pA$, which the proofs do not use.
Several of the inequalities are trivially true (positivity and range conditions in (P0), (SC2), (SC5), (SC35), (SC47) first part); they are
checked for completeness. The computations after the touch-down use the printed touch-down constants and the printed values of $D'$,
never their exact values, so the printed numbers are exactly the numbers to which the proofs refer. By Lemma~\ref{lem:mono} and the
monotonicity remark in the proof of Proposition~\ref{prop:cond}, the conditions at $(\vz,\epsS)$ imply those at every $v\le\vz$,
$\eps\le\epsS$. The integrals in $J_k(U_0)$ are bounded from above: in closed form on the pieces where $\rho_{\Cfl}$ is constant or
linear, and by left-endpoint Riemann sums on a geometric partition on the piece where it is given by the sine (there the integrand is
non-increasing). The script also confirms that the simplified formula for $\PsiI$ in Definition~\ref{def:param} agrees with the general one
on the branch selected by $K_f+1\le K_R$. It writes Tables~\ref{tab:core}--\ref{tab:side} below (this file is generated, not typed) and a
full log \texttt{verify\_constants.out}, which lists every condition with both sides and its relative slack, and every constant of
Definition~\ref{def:tdconst}, Definition~\ref{def:param} and Section~\ref{sec:proof} to $20$ digits or more. It ends with the line
\texttt{ALL 218 CONDITIONS HOLD} and exits with a non-zero status if any condition fails. To run it:
\begin{center}
\texttt{python -I verify\_constants.py}\qquad(about two minutes; output \texttt{appA\_tables.tex}, \texttt{verify\_constants.out}).
\end{center}
The smallest relative slacks are $0$ ($\vz=\vbar$), below $10^{-5}$ for the conditions that defined a rounded input (including the
certified bounds for $D'$, (P1), (P3), (P4) for $p$, (P5) for $p$ and (P6) for $\pA$), and $8.9\cdot10^{-4}$ for (C2) and $K_f+1\le K_R$;
Table~\ref{tab:side} lists the $32$ conditions with slack below $2\cdot10^{-3}$. All other conditions have slack at least $2.0\cdot10^{-3}$.
